title: My Omarchy profile
description: profile.json, version 1: the choices that make an Omarchy machine someone's own. It records what is wanted; the live machine stays the authority on what is in effect. Omarchy Control enforces these rules in src/profilemodel.cpp, and also refuses duplicate keys at any depth, which JSON Schema cannot express. Until the first public release, version 1 may still change.

schemaVersion.description: A newer version than the reader supports is refused before anything changes. Older ones are migrated in memory, with each change in meaning reported.

source.description: Where the profile was saved. Diagnostic only: never an instruction to install or downgrade anything, and never a path.

settings.description: Catalog setting id to the chosen state. A setting left out is unmanaged and left alone. An id this version does not know is kept and reported, never applied.

value.description: The catalog's normalized string for the value.

mode.description: Return to the destination's own default, only for settings that can do so reliably.

packages.description: Applications to install or remove. Restored from version P2 on. Leaving a package out never removes it; removal is only ever the explicit intent "absent".

source.description: "manual" is a package no reviewed source can install, such as a local build: listed for a person to handle.

repository.description: The repository it came from, for the record.

packages.$comment: Each name appears once: the same package both present and absent is refused.

desktop.description: Desktop choices made through Omarchy Control. Restored from version P3 on.

dockPins.description: The whole ordered list of pinned apps, as app ids the way Omarchy keeps them, without .desktop. A restore shows that it replaces the current list.

launchers.description: Launcher changes by app id: a new name, icon, or visibility.

icon.description: An icon name, or one of the profile's assets by digest.

associations.description: File type or URL scheme to the app that opens it.

shortcuts.description: Shortcuts Omarchy Control owns, merged by id. Each command is shown in the restore review before it can be bound.

themes.description: Themes installed from Git, by folder name, with where each came from. A restore clones one only where no theme of that name is installed yet, never replacing one, and does not switch to it: the appearance.theme setting selects it.

url.description: An https address with no user name or password in it, and no query or fragment.

bar.description: The bar's layout: Omarchy's own widgets in each section, in order, with options that are only data. Options that run a command or load a file (exec, source, type, onClick, and the like) are refused, since the bar makes an entry with one a module of its own. Widgets from plugins installed separately are not carried and, at a restore, keep their sections after these. A section left out is not managed: a restore leaves it alone, except that a widget placed elsewhere moves out of it.

plugins.description: Omarchy's own plugins that are switched off, as a whole list: a restore switches these off and the others back on, through Omarchy's own plugin commands. Bar widgets are on or off by being on the bar.

background.description: The background, for the theme it belongs to: one of that theme's own by file name, or, with sha256, one of the user's, whose file the profile holds in assets.

windowRules.description: Window rules Omarchy Control owns, merged by id. Rules in the user's own files are never touched.

files.description: Configuration files, stored at files/<adapter>/<name>. Each goes only where its reviewed adapter puts it; an adapter this version lacks refuses the whole profile. Restored from version P3 on.

assets.description: Backgrounds, icons, and theme files, stored by content at assets/sha256/<digest>. Restored from version P3 on.
assets.$comment: Each digest appears once, and files and assets together hold at most 100 MiB.

barOptionValue.description: Data only: text of at most 200 characters with no path in a home folder, numbers, switches, and lists and records of these, nested at most three deep.

themeFolder.description: A theme's folder name, held to the characters omarchy-theme-install allows.

plainName.description: A file name with no folders, never hidden.
